facts: Parties: Quayside Logistics plc (Buyer), Kingsmere Foods Ltd (Seller); the Company is Galloway Medical Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 6 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 8 July 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $275,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Redcliffe Technologies Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
